claim_text: Chronic excessive zinc intake can impair copper absorption and cause copper deficiency; total elemental zinc from all products must be reconciled before adding a supplement.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People already taking high-dose zinc or multiple zinc-containing products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes upper limits, copper effects and interactions.
limitations: No additional dose; assess total elemental zinc.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
